de: The first European school of higher learning in the Americas, Colegio de Santa Cruz de Tlatelolco, is founded by Viceroy Antonio de Mendoza and Bishop Juan de Zumárraga in Mexico City.
p: Colegio de Santa Cruz de Tlatelolco

t: 英国国王亨利八世在比武时发生事故，导致脑损伤，历史学家称这可能影响了他后来的古怪行为和可能的阳…
te: King Henry VIII of England suffers an accident while jousting, leading to a brain injury that historians say may have i…
dz: 英国国王亨利八世在比武时发生事故，导致脑损伤，历史学家称这可能影响了他后来的古怪行为和可能的阳痿。
de: King Henry VIII of England suffers an accident while jousting, leading to a brain injury that historians say may have influenced his later erratic behaviour and possible impotence.

t: 西班牙人佩德罗·德·门多萨 (Pedro de Mendoza) 创立了阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯。
te: Spaniard Pedro de Mendoza founds Buenos Aires, Argentina.
dz: 西班牙人佩德罗·德·门多萨 (Pedro de Mendoza) 创立了阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯。
de: Spaniard Pedro de Mendoza founds Buenos Aires, Argentina.

t: 查尔斯五世让皇家进入了罗马,摧毁了这座城市的一整块地来重新实现罗马的胜利.
te: Charles V makes a Royal Entry into Rome, demolishing a swath of the city to re-enact a Roman triumph.
dz: 查尔斯五世让皇家进入了罗马,摧毁了这座城市的一整块地来重新实现罗马的胜利.
de: Charles V makes a Royal Entry into Rome, demolishing a swath of the city to re-enact a Roman triumph.

t: 英国女王安妮·博林因通奸、乱伦、叛国和巫术罪名被捕入狱。
te: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, is arrested and imprisoned on charges of adultery, incest, treason and witchcraft.
dz: 英国女王安妮·博林因通奸、乱伦、叛国和巫术罪名被捕入狱。
de: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, is arrested and imprisoned on charges of adultery, incest, treason and witchcraft.

t: 库斯科之围开始,其中因坎部队试图从西班牙人手中夺回库斯科城.
te: The Siege of Cuzco commences, in which Incan forces attempt to retake the city of Cuzco from the Spanish.
dz: 库斯科之围开始,其中因坎部队试图从西班牙人手中夺回库斯科城.
de: The Siege of Cuzco commences, in which Incan forces attempt to retake the city of Cuzco from the Spanish.

t: 英国女王安妮·博林因叛国罪、通奸罪和乱伦罪在伦敦受审；她被专门挑选的陪审团判处死刑。
te: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, stands trial in London on charges of treason, adultery and incest; she is condemned to d…
dz: 英国女王安妮·博林因叛国罪、通奸罪和乱伦罪在伦敦受审；她被专门挑选的陪审团判处死刑。
de: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, stands trial in London on charges of treason, adultery and incest; she is condemned to death by a specially-selected jury.

t: 亨利八世和安妮博林的婚姻被废除。
te: Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn's marriage is annulled.
dz: 亨利八世和安妮博林的婚姻被废除。
de: Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn's marriage is annulled.

t: 乔治·博林 二世罗克福德等四人被以叛国罪处死.
te: George Boleyn, 2nd Viscount Rochford and four other men are executed for treason.
dz: 乔治·博林 二世罗克福德等四人被以叛国罪处死.
de: George Boleyn, 2nd Viscount Rochford and four other men are executed for treason.

t: 英格兰亨利八世的第二任妻子安妮·博林因通奸、叛国和乱伦被斩首。
te: Anne Boleyn, the second wife of Henry VIII of England, is beheaded for adultery, treason, and incest.
dz: 英格兰亨利八世的第二任妻子安妮·博林因通奸、叛国和乱伦被斩首。
de: Anne Boleyn, the second wife of Henry VIII of England, is beheaded for adultery, treason, and incest.

t: 英国国王亨利八世与他前两位妻子的侍女简·西摩结婚。
te: King Henry VIII of England marries Jane Seymour, a lady-in-waiting to his first two wives.
dz: 英国国王亨利八世与他前两位妻子的侍女简·西摩结婚。
de: King Henry VIII of England marries Jane Seymour, a lady-in-waiting to his first two wives.

t: 托马斯·莫尔在被伪证定罪后被处决.
te: Thomas More is executed after having been condemned on perjured evidence.
dz: 托马斯·莫尔在被伪证定罪后被处决.
de: Thomas More is executed after having been condemned on perjured evidence.

t: 探险家雅克·卡蒂埃(Jacques Cartier)在第二次出征北美后在圣马洛登陆. 他回来时…
te: The explorer Jacques Cartier lands at St. Malo at the end of his second expedition to North America. He returns with no…
dz: 探险家雅克·卡蒂埃(Jacques Cartier)在第二次出征北美后在圣马洛登陆. 他回来时没有找到任何金子.
de: The explorer Jacques Cartier lands at St. Malo at the end of his second expedition to North America. He returns with none of the gold he expected to find.

t: 雅克·卡地亚(Jacques Cartier,通航和探险家)在为法国争夺斯达科纳(魁北克),霍…
te: Jacques Cartier, navigator and explorer, returns home to St. Malo after claiming Stadacona (Quebec), Hochelaga (Montrea…
dz: 雅克·卡地亚(Jacques Cartier,通航和探险家)在为法国争夺斯达科纳(魁北克),霍赫拉加(蒙特利尔)和加拿大河(上劳伦斯河)地区后,回到了家乡圣马洛.
de: Jacques Cartier, navigator and explorer, returns home to St. Malo after claiming Stadacona (Quebec), Hochelaga (Montreal) and the River of Canada (St. Lawrence River) region for France.

t: 塞巴斯蒂安·德·贝拉尔卡扎尔在寻找埃尔多拉多时发现了圣地亚哥-德卡利市.
te: Sebastián de Belalcázar, on his search for El Dorado, founds the city of Santiago de Cali.
dz: 塞巴斯蒂安·德·贝拉尔卡扎尔在寻找埃尔多拉多时发现了圣地亚哥-德卡利市.
de: Sebastián de Belalcázar, on his search for El Dorado, founds the city of Santiago de Cali.

dz: 日本京都延历寺的佛教僧侣放火焚烧京都各地的21座日莲宗寺院，史称“天文法华之乱”。
de: Buddhist monks from Kyoto, Japan's Enryaku-ji temple set fire to 21 Nichiren temples throughout Kyoto in what will be known as the Tenbun Hokke Disturbance.
